topic: Robot manipulation, tactile/force contact, cross-embodiment/OOD generalization and demonstration/diffusion policies.
scope: Public research metadata discovery, no raw data, no experiments, no full-text review.
sources: Crossref REST API (45 targeted relevance-ranked searches, up to two pages of 250 per query)
CoRL published PMLR volume indexes listed in the publisher archive
RSS proceedings volumes listed in publisher archive
screening: Normalized English TITLE must match at least one topic expression and either a robotics context expression in the title or a robotics venue/arXiv cs.RO category. Some medical and dual-use topics excluded. No real-world validation inferred.

topic.manipulation-dexterity: \bmanipulat(?:ion|or|ors|ing|e|ive|able)\b|\bgrasp\w*\b|\bdexterous\b|\bdexterity\b|in hand|\bbimanual\b|deformable objects?|\bgrippers?\b|pick and place|peg in hole|robotic assembly|robot assembly|robot hand\b
topic.demonstration-policy-learning: imitation learning|learn\w* from demonstrations?|behavior(?:al)? clon(?:ing|e)|behaviour(?:al)? cloning|diffusion polic\w*|action chunk\w*|policy diffusion|teleoperation|robot demonstrations?|vision language action|visuomotor polic\w*|robot(?:ic)? polic(?:y|ies)|robot learning dataset|robot foundation model
topic.cross-robot-generalization: cross embod\w*|cross robot\w*|multi embod\w*|cross morphology|(?:robot|embodiment|policy) (?:generalization|generalisation|generalist|transfer)|generalist robot|sim to real|sim2real|domain randomization|out of distribution

rules.exclusions: \b(?:missile|weapon|munition|military|firearm|explosive|bomb|malware|cyberattack|cyber attack|pathogen|viral|virulence)\w*\b|(?:optical|ion|spin|magnetic) (?:micromanipulation|manipulation)|\b(?:molecular|nanoparticle) manipulation\b|\b(?:knee|stroke|rehabilitation|surgical|surgery|laparoscop\w*|catheter\w*|endoscop\w*|prosthes\w*|dental|exoskeleton\w*)\b|\b(?:erratum|corrigendum|retracted|retraction|withdrawn|front matter|preface|table of contents|author index|copyright|call for papers)\b

metadata_preference: RSS publisher, PMLR publisher, Crossref, arXiv. Year is publication year of the selected record; remaining matched URLs retained. CoRL may publish one year after event.
dedup: Connected components using exact normalized title, DOI if available, or URL (arXiv version removed). Distinct preprint titles may remain.
coverage_limits: Rank limits per query, English-title lexical filters, venue years index-dependent, missing dates excluded. Live Crossref totals are search estimates.
No full-text screening, no verification of real-robot trials per work, no quality or novelty conclusion.
Robotics-conference indexes can include sim-only work, peripheral methods and false positives. A paper-to-data link and rights are not established here.
